tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All tender condition as per the tender document
Tenderer in its name should achieved in at least Two Financial year a minimum Financial Turnover of Rs. 28.88 Lakhs, in last Three years i.e., 2023-24 to 2025-26
Satisfactory completed one similar nature of Contract of Value not less than Rs 14.44 Lakhs or Supply of 6 any Skilled or Unskilled Manpower to any Govt Dept, 2023-24 to 2025-26

Tenderer should submit a Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 8.66 Lakhs Credit lines/ letters of credit/ Certificates from Nationalized Banks for meeting the Fund requirement etc. (Conditional Banker Certificates are not accepted)
Karnataka Labour Department Registration Certificate (Valid certificate of Agency Issued by the Competent Authority)
Provident Fund (PF) Registration Certificate (Valid certificate of Agency Issued by the Competent Authority)
ESI Registration Certificate (Valid certificate of Agency Issued by the Competent Authority)
GST Registration Certificate and PAN card
